content: Across early April 2026 Alice planned a late-April trip to Kyoto: she settled on a traditional ryokan in Higashiyama near the Philosopher's Path and timed the visit for the last of the cherry blossoms.
summary: Alice's April 2026 Kyoto trip plan: a Higashiyama ryokan, timed for the cherry blossoms.
title: Alice's Kyoto trip plan
